title: Feasibility and safety of outpatient cardiac catheterization procedures
summary: The trial is a data collection from all patients undergoing a cardiac catheter exam in our institution. The focus was on possible complications occurring in a timely context at and around the examination. The patients were not admitted into hospital, but observed in our out patient unit and discharged after only a short (4-6 hours) observation period.
conditions: Potentially life-threatening conditions occurring in temporal association with outpatient cardiac catheterization procedures
Phlebitis and thrombophlebitis of other sites
Other specified complications of cardiac and vascular prosthetic devices, implants and grafts

interventions.name: All patients who undergo outpatient cardiac catheterization at our facility and are subsequently monitored are registered and included in the data collection.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients undergoing a cardiac catheterization procedure at the study facility.
Exclusion criteria:
None
